sources.title: Liquid AI LFM3: Open 2B Models for Text, Vision, Audio | explainx.ai ...
sources.snippet: Liquid AI has released LFM3, an open-weight family of six models in the roughly 2B-parameter class that cover text, vision with video, audio, omni input and calibrated decisions on a single shared backbone. The company's launch post on Hugging Face calls it a starting point for specialized intelligence you can fine-tune on one GPU.
